greatest_hits.note: Regalia Core + Bedrock Legs + Pistonfist + Girder Fist + Herald Crown, BACK empty; fought vs the same seeded opponent variants as the bit rows (shipped AI).

meta.notes: Combat is deterministic; variation comes from seeded per-slot opponent jitter (widely-available commons, CORE never jittered) and role alternation by seed parity. Fights run both-sides-AI with enemy_can_aim_core=true so both sides can close games. Score: WIN=1 for the player side, DEATH and SURVIVABLE_LOSS=1 for the enemy side, turn-cap stall=0.5 each. mean_delta = mean over (template, opponent, seed) of modified-template score minus that template's baseline score at the same seed.

pentagon_v2.policy: both sides: best affordable can_target_core SINGLE when it out-damages the part-break line; GUARD-when-behind (core HP ratio 0.15 below the foe's, never twice in a row); shipped default line otherwise
